# MyTuums

> The social media, for gamers.

MyTuums is a gaming-first social network: posts and threads, reposts and
quotes, likes and bookmarks, follows, and human-reviewed moderation with
in-app appeals. Most of the app requires an account; the pages below are
the public surface.

- App: [https://mytuums.com](https://mytuums.com)
- Create an account: [https://mytuums.com/register](https://mytuums.com/register)
- Sign in: [https://mytuums.com/login](https://mytuums.com/login)
- Privacy Policy: [https://mytuums.com/privacy](https://mytuums.com/privacy)
- Terms of Service: [https://mytuums.com/terms](https://mytuums.com/terms)
- Legal Notice: [https://mytuums.com/mentions-legales](https://mytuums.com/mentions-legales)
- Branding site: [https://about.mytuums.com](https://about.mytuums.com)

## Public post pages

Since 0.4.0, individual post permalinks under
`https://mytuums.com/post/<postId>` are publicly readable, including their
images. There is no public index or listing of posts — discoverability is
by link only. Everything else (feeds, profiles, search, notifications)
requires signing in.

## Notes

- The landing site ([https://about.mytuums.com](https://about.mytuums.com))
  is available in English and French; the language is chosen in the page
  header.
- AI and search crawlers are welcome on the public pages above under the
  same [robots.txt](https://mytuums.com/robots.txt) rules as everyone else.
